tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The night's headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo faces Milwaukee for the first time since the trade, and Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware and Kasparas Jakucionis all return to Miami. The market has this as a blowout — Miami -11.5 with a 237 total — and our fair number agrees the Heat should win, at 85.3%. No price on the side clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Miami -11.5: the Heat at home, whole again, with their star's old team in town.
games.title: Bucks at Heat: Giannis faces Milwaukee for the first time
games.verdict: LEAN: MIA -11.5 — no true edge on the side; the Heat at home, whole again, against the team that traded their star.

games.take: Philadelphia is 12-3 and short a piece — Jaylen Brown is out with a hamstring strain — but LeBron James and Joel Embiid are expected to play. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain), which is the bigger absence: the Magic lose their best scorer and creator against a 76ers side that can score in bunches. Our fair number makes Philadelphia a narrow 53.2% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Philadelphia -1.5: the healthier star power on the road.
games.title: 76ers at Magic: Banchero out, Philly's stars in
games.verdict: LEAN: PHI -1.5 — no true edge on the side; the 12-3 76ers with Embiid and LeBron expected in, against a Magic side missing Banchero.

games.take: Memphis is 10-4 and 7-0 on the road, and rookie Cameron Boozer just dropped a career-high 29 on Monday. Cleveland is 8-7 with Donovan Mitchell back and rolling after a season-high 39, but Evan Mobley (toe) is out, which thins the frontcourt against a Grizzlies team that plays fast. Our fair number makes Cleveland a 63.6% favorite at home, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Memphis +4.5: the road record is real, and the Cavs are short-handed up front.
games.title: Grizzlies at Cavaliers: the NBA's best road team visits Cleveland
games.verdict: LEAN: MEM +4.5 — no true edge on the side; Memphis is 7-0 on the road and Cleveland is without Mobley.

games.take: The board's first edge lives here: Toronto moneyline at -225 (Circa) is +0.9% EV against our devigged Pinnacle fair of 69.9% — every other US book is -243 or longer, so Circa is the stale number. Washington has lost eight straight; Toronto has lost five straight and is on the second night of a back-to-back after losing to the Knicks, and Kawhi Leonard is still out. Even so, the Raptors are the better side at home against the team with the league's worst stretch. No true edge on the spread, but the lean is Toronto -6.5, and the moneyline is the board play.
games.title: Wizards at Raptors: the board's first edge lives here
games.verdict: LEAN: TOR -6.5 — no true edge on the spread. (Board play: Toronto Raptors ML -225 (Circa), +0.9% EV.)

games.take: A reunion game with a thinned-out feel on both sides. Lu Dort and Aaron Wiggins return to Oklahoma City for the first time since they were traded to Atlanta, but the Hawks are without CJ McCollum and five others, while the Thunder are missing Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams, and Jaylin Williams is out with back spasms. Our fair number makes Oklahoma City a 70.0% favorite at home, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Oklahoma City -6.5: the Thunder at home against a Hawks side missing half its rotation.
games.title: Hawks at Thunder: Dort and Wiggins return to OKC
games.verdict: LEAN: OKC -6.5 — no true edge on the side; the Thunder at home against a Hawks side missing McCollum and five others.

games.take: Boston is 11-3 with a clean injury report and opens a four-game road trip in Denver, the second game of ESPN's doubleheader. Our fair number makes the Celtics a 57.0% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Boston -2.5: the healthier, hotter team laying a short number on the road.
games.title: Celtics at Nuggets: Boston opens its road trip in Denver
games.verdict: LEAN: BOS -2.5 — no true edge on the side; the 11-3 Celtics with a clean report against a Nuggets side catching them on the road.

games.take: The Lakers are 11-2 and the Jazz are 1-11, and both sides are on the second night of a back-to-back. Austin Reaves is out for Los Angeles, which puts even more on Luka Doncic — and the one eye-catching prop number on the slate, Doncic Over 53.5 PRA at +110, lives only at Bovada (+5.0% vs the FanDuel fair), so it stays off the board: a price you can't bet at a US book is not an edge. Our fair number makes the Lakers a 79.3% favorite, and no side price clears our 0.75% bar. No true edge, but the lean is Los Angeles -10.0: the best team in the West at home against the worst.
games.title: Jazz at Lakers: the West's best hosts the West's worst
games.verdict: LEAN: LAL -10.0 — no true edge on the side; the 11-2 Lakers at home against a 1-11 Jazz side.

games.take: The board's second edge lives here: Collin Gillespie Under 1.5 Steals at -207 (DraftKings) is +1.1% EV against our devigged FanDuel fair of 68.2%. Gillespie is under 1.5 steals in 5 of his last 10, playing about 25 minutes off the bench. On the game itself, Phoenix has won five of seven including its first road win Monday in Denver, while Sacramento is 1-12, has lost six straight and hasn't won at home. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery; De'Andre Hunter and Precious Achiuwa are questionable for the Kings. Our fair number makes Phoenix a 70.3% favorite, and the lean is Phoenix -7.0.
games.title: Suns at Kings: the board's second edge lives here
games.verdict: LEAN: PHX -7.0 — no true edge on the spread. (Board play: Collin Gillespie Under 1.5 Steals -207 (DraftKings), +1.1% EV.)
